description: This file provides an API client implementation with functions for constructing URLs, making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE), and specific API endpoint helpers such as listing users, sessions, deployments, and costs. It also includes internal helpers for URL building and response parsing.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Detects whether a given URL string is an absolute URL (starts with 'http://' or 'https://').

methods.name: buildUrl(pathOrUrl)
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by combining a base URL with a relative path or an absolute URL, handling special cases like '/api' and ensuring proper concatenation.

methods.name: toQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Converts a parameters object into a URL-encoded query string, supporting arrays and nested objects.

methods.name: parseResponse(res)
methods.description: Parses the fetch response, returning an object with 'ok', 'status', and 'payload', handling JSON and text responses.

methods.name: httpGet(pathOrUrl, { params, headers, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to a given path or URL, with optional query parameters, headers, and abort signal; throws an error if the response is not successful.

methods.name: httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with specified method, URL, and body, setting appropriate headers; throws an error on failure.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload(payload)
methods.description: Normalizes the payload received from list endpoints to an object with 'items', 'total', and 'meta'.

methods.name: getApiClient()
methods.description: Returns an object mimicking an axios-like client with methods for get, post, put, delete that internally use fetch.

methods.name: health()
methods.description: Checks the backend health status by sending requests to root or '/api/auth/health', returning response data.

methods.name: listUsers(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of users with optional parameters, returning normalized data.

methods.name: listSessions(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches session tracking records with optional parameters, returning normalized data.

methods.name: listDeployments(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches application deployment data with optional parameters, returning normalized data.

methods.name: listLlmCosts(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches LLM cost records with optional parameters, returning normalized data.

ctags.name: httpJson
ctags.pattern: /^async function httpJson(method, pathOrUrl, body, { headers, signal } = {}) {$/
